```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
mallards |>
  count(month, month_num, year, season, name = "gps_fixes") |>
  arrange(year, month_num)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(ggridges)

mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = season)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = "Speed",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Season"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
